source.label: mtgo.com decklists: Vintage Eternal Weekend: Library

notes.text: Placings (1 to 8, as magic.gg numbers them) are from magic.gg's Library of Alexandria Championship results table.

Date: the event started 2020-10-24 at 14:05 PDT (21:05 UTC) with ten Swiss rounds, so the Top 8 ran from about midnight Pacific into the early hours of 2020-10-25 (both Pacific and UTC). mtgo.com files the event under its start date, 2020-10-24.
Magic Online lists each printing of a card on its own line; copies of the same card are added together here.
Seeds are the seeding shown in mtgo.com's Top 8 bracket.

Archetype names are MTGGoldfish's, for consistency across events. Kept from the earlier source where Goldfish names only colours or lists no deck: KevinCron (Goldfish: 'WUR'); Tezzeret01 (Goldfish: 'WUBR'); stonepeanut (Goldfish: 'Colorless'); WingedHussar (Goldfish: 'WUBRG'); 0inksterthepig (Goldfish: 'URG').
